verses.sloka: तासां विलपमानानां तथा राक्षसयोषिताम् ।ज्येष्ठा पत्नी प्रिया दीना भर्तारं समुदैक्षत ।। ६.११४.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāsāṁ vilapamānānāṁ tathā rākṣasayoṣitām ।jyeṣṭhā patnī priyā dīnā bhartāraṁ samudaikṣata ।। 6.114.1 ।।

translations.english: Then from among the wives lamenting, the first wife, dear to Ravana gazed at her husband lamenting piteously.

verses.sloka: दशग्रीवं हतं दृष्ट्वा रामेणाचिन्त्यकर्मणा ।पतिं मण्डोदरी तत्र कृपणा पर्यदेवयत् ।। ६.११४.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: daśagrīvaṁ hataṁ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇācintyakarmaṇā ।patiṁ maṇḍodarī tatra kṛpaṇā paryadevayat ।। 6.114.2 ।।

translations.english: Looking at her husband Ravana killed by Rama of inconceivable exploits, Mandodari piteously lamented there.
translations.hindi: देवताओं सहित उस युद्ध को देखने के लिए आए हुए ऋषि- श्रेष्ठ भगवान्‌ अगस्त्य जी, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के निकट जा कर, बोले

verses.sloka: ननु नाम महाभाग तव वैश्रवणानुज ।क्रुद्धस्य प्रमुखे स्थातुं त्रस्यत्यपि पुरन्दरः ।। ६.११४.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: nanu nāma mahābhāga tava vaiśravaṇānuja ।kruddhasya pramukhe sthātuṁ trasyatyapi purandaraḥ ।। 6.114.3 ।।

translations.english: "O mighty armed Ravana! O, brother of Visrava! When in anger even Purandara was afraid to stand before you, it is well known."
translations.hindi: हे वत्स! हे महाबाहो ! हे राम ! जिस स्तोत्र के पाठ करने से तुम युद्ध में अपने ससस्त शत्रुओं को जीत सको उस वेदवत्‌ नित्य और गोपनीय आदित्यहृदय स्तोत्र को ( मैं बतलाता हूँ ) तुस सुनो

verses.sloka: ऋषयश्च महीदेवा गन्धर्वाश्च यशस्विनः ।। ६.११४.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayaśca mahīdevā gandharvāśca yaśasvinaḥ ।। 6.114.4 ।।

translations.english: "For fear of you, even great seers, illustrious Gandharvas, Charanas also went in all directions, is well known."
translations.hindi: आदित्यहृदय स्तात्र वेद की तरह नित्य ( सदा रहने बाला ) हे, इसका पाठ करने से यह पाठ करने बाले के पुण्य को बढ़ाने वाला है, समस्त शत्रुओं का नाश करने बाला है, विजयप्रद है, नित्य पाठ करने से यह पाठ करने वाले को अन्षय्य फल देने वाला ओर परम कल्याण करने बाला है अथवा परम पवित्र है

verses.sloka: ननु नाम तवोद्वेगाच्चारणाश्च दिशो गताः ।स त्वं मानुषमात्रेण रामेण युधि निर्जितः ।न व्यपत्रपसे राजन् किमिदं राक्षसर्षभ ।। ६.११४.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: nanu nāma tavodvegāccāraṇāśca diśo gatāḥ ।sa tvaṁ mānuṣamātreṇa rāmeṇa yudhi nirjitaḥ ।na vyapatrapase rājan kimidaṁ rākṣasarṣabha ।। 6.114.5 ।।

translations.english: "O Lord of Rakshasas! Just by Rama, a mortal, you have been killed in war. Are you not shy of it?"
translations.hindi: यह्‌ सबंमङ्गलों का भो मङ्गल करने वाला और समस्त पापों का नाश करने वाला है । यह चिन्ता और शोक अथवा आधिव्याधि को मिटाने वाला और दौघांयु करने बाला हे. अर्थात्‌ निर्दिष्ट आयु को बढ़ाने वाला है और पाठ करने योग्य स्तोत्रां में यह सर्वश्रेष्ठ है

verses.sloka: कथं त्रैलोक्यमाक्रम्य श्रिया वीर्येण चान्वितम् ।अविषह्यं जघान त्वां मानुषो वनगोचरः ।। ६.११४.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: kathaṁ trailokyamākramya śriyā vīryeṇa cānvitam ।aviṣahyaṁ jaghāna tvāṁ mānuṣo vanagocaraḥ ।। 6.114.6 ।।

translations.english: "Winning the three worlds by your valour, you are glorious, irresistible and beyond reach. How did the wanderer in the forest strike you?"
translations.hindi: तुम सुवणं की तरह श्रष्ठ किरणों वाले, पूर्ण बिम्ब से सदा उद्य होने बाले ( चन्द्रमा की तरह घटने बढ्ने बाले नहीं ), सुर असुर से पूज्य, अपने प्रकाश से समस्त पदार्थो को प्रकाशित करने बाले, ( बिवस्त्रन्तं ) भुवनेश्वर ( वषा और गर्मी में समस्त १ अक्षय्यं--अन्ञय्यफलकर | ( गो० ) २ परमंशिवं --परमपावन |. ( गोऽ ) fe rE ११४८ युद्धकाण्डे सु बनों के नियन्ता) भास्कर अर्थात्‌ सूर्य भगवान्‌ को तुम आदित्य- हृदय स्तोत्र के पाठ से प्रसन्न करो

verses.sloka: मानुषाणामविषये चरतः कामरूपिणः ।विनाशस्तव रामेण संयुगे नोपपद्यते ।। ६.११४.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: mānuṣāṇāmaviṣaye carataḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ।vināśastava rāmeṇa saṁyuge nopapadyate ।। 6.114.7 ।।

translations.english: "You lived in an inaccessible place and are capable of assuming any form at will. It is not believable how you have been destroyed by Rama."
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--देवतान्तर के "पूजन का अनुरोध करने का कारण अतलाते हुए अगस्त्य जी कहते हैं ] र ~ ~ सवदेवात्मको ह्येष तेजस्वी रश्मिभावनः । एष देवासुरगणाँछोकान पाति गभस्तिभिः

verses.sloka: न चैतत् कर्म रामस्य श्रद्दधामि चमूमुखे ।सर्वतः समुपेतस्य तव तेनाभिमर्शनम् ।। ६.११४.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: na caitat karma rāmasya śraddadhāmi camūmukhe ।sarvataḥ samupetasya tava tenābhimarśanam ।। 6.114.8 ।।

translations.english: "You are always well equipped with the army, so such action (killing you) is not possible for Rama."
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--अगस्त्य जो अगले श्लोक में सूर्य का सर्वदेवात्मकत्व अर्थात्‌ समस्त देवताओं के आत्मरूप होने का विस्तारपूर्वक वर्णन करते है । ) एष ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च शिवः स्कन्दः प्रजापतिः । महेन्द्रो धनदः कालो यमः सोमो ह्यपांपतिः

verses.sloka: यदैव च जनस्थाने राक्षसैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ।खरस्तव हतो भ्राता तदेवासौ न मानुषः ।। ६.११४.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: yadaiva ca janasthāne rākṣasairbahubhirvṛtaḥ ।kharastava hato bhrātā tadevāsau na mānuṣaḥ ।। 6.114.9 ।।

translations.english: " At Janasthana your brother Khara, who was surrounded by many Rakshasas, was killed by a mortal in the same manner."

verses.sloka: यदैव नगरीं लङ्कां दुष्प्रवेशां सुरैरपि ।प्रविष्टो हनुमान् वीर्यात्तदैव व्यथिता वयम् ।। ६.११४.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: yadaiva nagarīṁ laṅkāṁ duṣpraveśāṁ surairapi ।praviṣṭo hanumān vīryāttadaiva vyathitā vayam ।। 6.114.10 ।।

translations.english: "To Lanka, which is inaccessible to anyone, Hanuman entered by increasing his valour. Knowing this we worried (that Rama may not be mere mortal)."
translations.hindi: ही अश्विनीकुमार, ये ही अझ और ये ही शरीरस्थ उपादान कारण होने से : सप्लोत्तरशत्रतमः सगः ११४६ [ टिप्पणो-इसके आगे आदित्यहृदय आरम्भ होता है ] सूर्य की नामावली आदित्यः सविता सूयः खगः पूषा गभस्तिमान्‌ । ` सुवणसदशो यानुर्हिरण्यरेता दित्राकरः

verses.sloka: यदैव वानरैर्घोरैर्बद्धः सेतुर्महार्णवे ।तदैव हृदयेनाहं शङ्के रामममानुषम् ।। ६.११४.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: yadaiva vānarairghorairbaddhaḥ seturmahārṇave ।tadaiva hṛdayenāhaṁ śaṅke rāmamamānuṣam ।। 6.114.11 ।।

translations.english: "When these terrific Vanaras constructed a bridge over the great ocean, I doubted in my mind at that time itself that Rama is not a mortal."

verses.sloka: अथवा रामरूपेण कृतान्तः स्वयमागतः ।मायां तव विनाशाय विधायाप्रतितर्किताम् ।। ६.११४.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: athavā rāmarūpeṇa kṛtāntaḥ svayamāgataḥ ।māyāṁ tava vināśāya vidhāyāpratitarkitām ।। 6.114.12 ।।

translations.english: "Or else, the god of death would have come in the form of Rama for your destruction, having right knowledge and taking an inconceivable recourse.

verses.sloka: अथवा वासवेन त्वं धर्षितो ऽसि महाबल ।वासवस्य कुतः शक्तिस्त्वां द्रष्टुमपि संयुगे ।। ६.११४.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: athavā vāsavena tvaṁ dharṣito 'si mahābala ।vāsavasya kutaḥ śaktistvāṁ draṣṭumapi saṁyuge ।। 6.114.13 ।।

translations.english: "Or else O king of extraordinary might! Indra would have come to overthrow you in the form of Rama. Indra has no energy even to look at you in the battlefield."
translations.hindi: व्योमनाथ, तमोभेदी, ऋगयजु-साम-पारग, घनत्रृष्टि , उप्रपां मित्र, विन्ध्यवी थी, सवङ्गम

verses.sloka: व्यक्तमेष महायोगी परमात्मा सनातनः ।अनादिमध्यनिधनो महतः परमो महान् ।। ६.११४.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: vyaktameṣa mahāyogī paramātmā sanātanaḥ ।anādimadhyanidhano mahataḥ paramo mahān ।। 6.114.14 ।।

translations.english: "It is evident that this Rama is a great yogi, eternal, who has no beginning, middle or end. He is supreme, greater than great and stands beyond darkness, a sustainer. He holds conch, discus, and mace in hand. He has symbols of Srivatsa on his chest. He is ever rich, invincible, everlasting, steady supreme soul and of truthful valour. He is prosperous, a mass of brilliance, Lord Vishnu and the Lord of all worlds, a wellwisher of all. He has come in mortal form, in the form of Vanaras also, and by all gods. He vanquished you along with Rakshasas is evident."
translations.hindi: नक्षत्रप्रइताराधिप, विश्वभावन, तेजो में सब से बढ़ कर तेजस्वी ॥ क [ टि प्पणी-- इस नामावली के बाद सूर्य के नमस्कार का प्रकरण आरम्भ होता है ] हे(द्वादशात्मन्‌ ! आपको नमस्कार है

verses.sloka: तमसः परमो धाता शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः ।श्रीवत्सवक्षा नित्यश्रीरजय्यः शाश्वतो ध्रुवः ।। ६.११४.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamasaḥ paramo dhātā śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ ।śrīvatsavakṣā nityaśrīrajayyaḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ ।। 6.114.15 ।।

translations.english: "It is evident that this Rama is a great yogi, eternal, who has no beginning, middle or end. He is supreme, greater than great and stands beyond darkness, a sustainer. He holds conch, discus, and mace in hand. He has symbols of Srivatsa on his chest. He is ever rich, invincible, everlasting, steady supreme soul and of truthful valour. He is prosperous, a mass of brilliance, Lord Vishnu and the Lord of all worlds, a wellwisher of all. He has come in mortal form, in the form of Vanaras also, and by all gods. He vanquished you along with Rakshasas is evident."

verses.sloka: मानुषं वपुरास्थाय विष्णुः सत्यपराक्रमः ।सर्वैः परिवृतो देवैर्वानरत्वमुपागतैः ।। ६.११४.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: mānuṣaṁ vapurāsthāya viṣṇuḥ satyaparākramaḥ ।sarvaiḥ parivṛto devairvānaratvamupāgataiḥ ।। 6.114.16 ।।

translations.english: "It is evident that this Rama is a great yogi, eternal, who has no beginning, middle or end. He is supreme, greater than great and stands beyond darkness, a sustainer. He holds conch, discus, and mace in hand. He has symbols of Srivatsa on his chest. He is ever rich, invincible, everlasting, steady supreme soul and of truthful valour. He is prosperous, a mass of brilliance, Lord Vishnu and the Lord of all worlds, a wellwisher of all. He has come in mortal form, in the form of Vanaras also, and by all gods. He vanquished you along with Rakshasas is evident."
translations.hindi: हे उदयाचल ओर अस्ताचलवर्ती ! आपको प्रणाम है। हे प्रहनक्षत्रों के स्वामी ! ओर हे दिनाधिप ( दिन के स्वामी ) ! आपको प्रणाम है

verses.sloka: सर्वलोकेश्वरः साक्षाल्लोकानां हितकाम्यया ।सराक्षसपरीवारं हतवांस्त्वां महाद्युतिः ।। ६.११४.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvalokeśvaraḥ sākṣāllokānāṁ hitakāmyayā ।sarākṣasaparīvāraṁ hatavāṁstvāṁ mahādyutiḥ ।। 6.114.17 ।।

translations.english: "It is evident that this Rama is a great yogi, eternal, who has no beginning, middle or end. He is supreme, greater than great and stands beyond darkness, a sustainer. He holds conch, discus, and mace in hand. He has symbols of Srivatsa on his chest. He is ever rich, invincible, everlasting, steady supreme soul and of truthful valour. He is prosperous, a mass of brilliance, Lord Vishnu and the Lord of all worlds, a wellwisher of all. He has come in mortal form, in the form of Vanaras also, and by all gods. He vanquished you along with Rakshasas is evident."
translations.hindi: हे जय! हे जयभद्र ! हे हयेश्व ! आपको प्रणाम है। हे सह- सांशु ! आपको प्रणाम हे । हे आदित्य ! आपको प्रणाम है

verses.sloka: इन्द्रियाणि पुरा जित्वा जितं त्रिभुवनं त्वया ।स्मरद्भिरिव तद्वैरमिन्द्रियैरेव निर्जितः ।। ६.११४.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇi purā jitvā jitaṁ tribhuvanaṁ tvayā ।smaradbhiriva tadvairamindriyaireva nirjitaḥ ।। 6.114.18 ।।

translations.english: "In the past by winning your senses you gained the three worlds. Now it seems as though the senses have recollected and taken their grudge. You have lost control over your senses, thereby you are killed by your enemy."

verses.sloka: क्रियतामविरोधश्च राघवेणेति यन्मया ।उच्यमानो न गृह्णासि तस्येयं व्युष्टिरागता ।। ६.११४.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: kriyatāmavirodhaśca rāghaveṇeti yanmayā ।ucyamāno na gṛhṇāsi tasyeyaṁ vyuṣṭirāgatā ।। 6.114.19 ।।

translations.english: " At Janasthana when your brother Khara was surrounded by many Rakshasas also he got killed by a mortal. So also, when Hanuman entered the city of Lanka, which is difficult to enter even for gods, I got perturbed."

verses.sloka: अकस्माच्चाभिकामो ऽसि सीतां राक्षसपुङ्गव ।ऐश्वर्यस्य विनाशाय देहस्य स्वजनस्य च ।। ६.११४.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: akasmāccābhikāmo 'si sītāṁ rākṣasapuṅgava ।aiśvaryasya vināśāya dehasya svajanasya ca ।। 6.114.20 ।।

translations.english: " At Janasthana when your brother Khara was surrounded by many Rakshasas also he got killed by a mortal. So also, when Hanuman entered the city of Lanka, which is difficult to enter even for gods, I got perturbed."
translations.hindi: हे तमोन्न ! हे हिमन्न ! हे शत्रन्न ! हे अमितात्मन्‌ ! हें कृतन्न ! हे देव ! हे ज्योतिषपते ! आपको प्रणाम है

verses.sloka: अरुन्धत्या विशिष्टां तां रोहिण्याश्चापि दुर्मते ।सीतां धर्षयता मान्यां त्वया ह्यसदृशं कृतम् ।। ६.११४.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: arundhatyā viśiṣṭāṁ tāṁ rohiṇyāścāpi durmate ।sītāṁ dharṣayatā mānyāṁ tvayā hyasadṛśaṁ kṛtam ।। 6.114.21 ।।

translations.english: "You were advised by me not to have any hostile action with Rama. You had not listened to me. This is the result of that action."

verses.sloka: वसुधायाश्च वसुधां श्रियः श्रीं भर्तृवत्सलाम् ।सीतां सर्वानवद्याङ्गीमरण्ये विजने शुभाम् ।। ६.११४.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: vasudhāyāśca vasudhāṁ śriyaḥ śrīṁ bhartṛvatsalām ।sītāṁ sarvānavadyāṅgīmaraṇye vijane śubhām ।। 6.114.22 ।।

translations.english: "O Foremost of Rakshasas! To the destruction of your wealth, life and your own people you suddenly developed passion for Sita."
translations.hindi: हे राम! ) यह प्रभु दिवाकर ही समस्त प्राणियों को उत्पन्न, पालन और नाश किआ करते हैं। सूयं भगवान्‌ ही अपनी किरणों से शोषण करते हैं, तपाते हैं और वर्षा करते हैँ

verses.sloka: आनयित्वा तु तां दीनां छद्मना ऽ ऽत्मस्वदूषण ।अप्राप्य चैव तं कामं मैथिलीसङ्कमे कृतम् ।पतिव्रतायास्तपसा नूनं दग्धो ऽसि मे प्रभो ।। ६.११४.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: ānayitvā tu tāṁ dīnāṁ chadmanā ' 'tmasvadūṣaṇa ।aprāpya caiva taṁ kāmaṁ maithilīsaṅkame kṛtam ।pativratāyāstapasā nūnaṁ dagdho 'si me prabho ।। 6.114.23 ।।

translations.english: "O evil minded king! Sita is to be respected even more than Arundathi or Rohini. Your arrogant action to her is unworthy."
translations.hindi: ये हा समस्त प्राणियों के सोने पर जागा करते हैं । ये ही सब आंणयों में अन्तर्यामी रूप से रहते हैं । ये ही अप्निद्दोत्र और ये ही अभिहोत्रियों को फल वेने वाले हैं. अथवा अभ्निहोत्र का फल स्वरूप ये ही हैं

verses.sloka: तदैव यन्न दग्धस्त्वं धर्षयंस्तनुमध्यमाम् ।देवा बिभ्यति ते सर्वे सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः ।। ६.११४.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadaiva yanna dagdhastvaṁ dharṣayaṁstanumadhyamām ।devā bibhyati te sarve sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ ।। 6.114.24 ।।

translations.english: "O king! You dishonoured your wives and me. Sita, who is tolerant as the goddess of earth, prosperous, goddess of fortune, who is fond of her husband, charming in all respects, living alone in the forest, an auspicious one, desperate, was brought in disguise by you. Before you cherished your desire to be in union with Mythili, surely you got burnt by her austerity."
translations.hindi: ये ही समस्त यज्ञों के अधिष्ठाता देवता और ये ही यज्ञों के फल स्वरूप भी हैं। लोकों में लितने काम होते हैं, उन सब के ये सूय हो नियन्ता हैं

verses.sloka: अवश्यमेव लभते फलं पापस्य कर्मणः ।घोरं पर्यागते काले कर्ता नास्त्यत्र संशयः ।। ६.११४.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: avaśyameva labhate phalaṁ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ ।ghoraṁ paryāgate kāle kartā nāstyatra saṁśayaḥ ।। 6.114.25 ।।

translations.english: "O king! You dishonoured your wives and me. Sita, who is tolerant as the goddess of earth, prosperous, goddess of fortune, who is fond of her husband, charming in all respects, living alone in the forest, an auspicious one, desperate, was brought in disguise by you. Before you cherished your desire to be in union with Mythili, surely you got burnt by her austerity."
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी-इ सके आगे स्तोत्र की फलस्तुति कही गई है । ] एनमापत्सु कच्छ पु कान्तारेषु भयेषु च । कोतयन्‌ पुरुषः कश्चिन्नावसीदति राघव

verses.sloka: शुभकृच्छुभमाप्नोति पापकृत् पापमश्नुते ।विभीषणः सुखं प्राप्तस्त्वं प्राप्तः पापमीदृशम् ।। ६.११४.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: śubhakṛcchubhamāpnoti pāpakṛt pāpamaśnute ।vibhīṣaṇaḥ sukhaṁ prāptastvaṁ prāptaḥ pāpamīdṛśam ।। 6.114.26 ।।

translations.english: "When you touched Sita of slender waist, at that time itself you were not burnt. All gods including Indra headed by fire god are approaching you with hostile intention."
translations.hindi: श्रीसूय भगवान की ओर देखते हुए ( अर्थात्‌ पर्वामि मुख हो कर ) इस स्तोत्र का पाठ करने से श्रोरामचन्द्र जी परम हर्षित हुए । पाठ करने के बाद तीन बार आचमन कर, एवं पवित्र हो ओर धनुष ले बीयवान्‌ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने

verses.sloka: सन्त्यन्याः प्रमदास्तुभ्यं रूपेणाभ्यधिकास्ततः ।अनङ्गवशमापन्नस्त्वं तु मोहान्न बुध्यसे ।। ६.११४.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: santyanyāḥ pramadāstubhyaṁ rūpeṇābhyadhikāstataḥ ।anaṅgavaśamāpannastvaṁ tu mohānna budhyase ।। 6.114.27 ।।

translations.english: "When time comes surely one who does sinful action will reap the result. There is no doubt that the doer of a terrible action will be destroyed."

verses.sloka: न कुलेन न रूपेण न दाक्षिण्येन मैथिली ।मया ऽधिका वा तुल्या वा त्वं तु मोहान्न बुध्यसे ।। ६.११४.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: na kulena na rūpeṇa na dākṣiṇyena maithilī ।mayā 'dhikā vā tulyā vā tvaṁ tu mohānna budhyase ।। 6.114.28 ।।

translations.english: "Mythili by race is not superior to me even a little, not in civility. Out of infatuation you did not perceive this."
translations.hindi: अगस्त्य मुनि के इस स्तोत्र के उपदेश से महातेजस्वो श्रीराम- न्द्र जीं का शोक नष्ट हो गया । प्रयत्नबान्‌ श्रोरामचन्द्र जी ने € श्रद्धाभक्तिपूबक आदित्यह्ृदयस्तोत्र का पाठ किआ

verses.sloka: सर्वथा सर्वभूतानां नास्ति मृत्युरलक्षणः ।तव तावदयं मृत्युर्मैथिलीकृतलक्षणः ।। ६.११४.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvathā sarvabhūtānāṁ nāsti mṛtyuralakṣaṇaḥ ।tava tāvadayaṁ mṛtyurmaithilīkṛtalakṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.114.29 ।।

translations.english: "Death does not happen without reason for any being. To you this happened because of getting Mythili."

verses.sloka: सीतानिमित्तजो मृत्युस्त्वया दूरादुपाहृतः ।। ६.११४.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: sītānimittajo mṛtyustvayā dūrādupāhṛtaḥ ।। 6.114.30 ।।

translations.english: "On account of abducting Sita, you invited death from a distance. Devoid of sorrow, Sita will sport with Rama."
translations.hindi: र।क्षसराज रावण को लड़ने के लिए आया हुआ देख, श्रीराम जी ने हर्षित मन से, उसका वध करने को, सब प्रकार से बड़े बड़े प्रयतनों से काम लिआ

verses.sloka: मैथिली सह रामेण विशोका विहरिष्यति ।अल्पपुण्या त्वहं घोरे पतिता शोकसागरे ।। ६.११४.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: maithilī saha rāmeṇa viśokā vihariṣyati ।alpapuṇyā tvahaṁ ghore patitā śokasāgare ।। 6.114.31 ।।

translations.english: "O Hero! Whose stock of merit was less, that you have tumbled down into an ocean of grief. I, having sported with you, clad in picturesque robes and the like, by the aerial car Chaitra ratha on mount Kailasa, Mount Meru and Mandara as well as in divine gardens all over, and various lands with matchless splendour, have been deprived of sensual pleasures because of your falling down. What a pity I am surrounded by ordinary women changed into another woman with fleeting fortunes!"
translations.hindi: इति सप्तोत्तरशततमः सगः सूय भगवान्‌ , श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को अपनी स्तुति करते हुए देख कर, सन्तुष्ट हो परम प्रसन्न हुए और देवताओं के बीच स्थित हो बोले कि हे वत्स ! रावण के बध में अब शीघ्रता करो अर्थात रावण का वध शीघ्र करो

verses.sloka: कैलासे मन्दरे मेरौ तथा चैत्ररथे वने ।देवोद्यानेषु सर्वेषु विहृत्य सहिता त्वया ।। ६.११४.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: kailāse mandare merau tathā caitrarathe vane ।devodyāneṣu sarveṣu vihṛtya sahitā tvayā ।। 6.114.32 ।।

translations.english: "O Hero! Whose stock of merit was less, that you have tumbled down into an ocean of grief. I, having sported with you, clad in picturesque robes and the like, by the aerial car Chaitra ratha on mount Kailasa, Mount Meru and Mandara as well as in divine gardens all over, and various lands with matchless splendour, have been deprived of sensual pleasures because of your falling down. What a pity I am surrounded by ordinary women changed into another woman with fleeting fortunes!"

verses.sloka: विमानेनानुरूपेण या याम्यतुलया श्रिया ।पश्यन्ती विविधान् देशांस्तांस्तांश्चित्रस्रगम्बरा ।भ्रंशिता कामभोगेभ्यः सा ऽस्मि वीर वधात्तव ।। ६.११४.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: vimānenānurūpeṇa yā yāmyatulayā śriyā ।paśyantī vividhān deśāṁstāṁstāṁścitrasragambarā ।bhraṁśitā kāmabhogebhyaḥ sā 'smi vīra vadhāttava ।। 6.114.33 ।।

translations.english: "O Hero! Whose stock of merit was less, that you have tumbled down into an ocean of grief. I, having sported with you, clad in picturesque robes and the like, by the aerial car Chaitra ratha on mount Kailasa, Mount Meru and Mandara as well as in divine gardens all over, and various lands with matchless splendour, have been deprived of sensual pleasures because of your falling down. What a pity I am surrounded by ordinary women changed into another woman with fleeting fortunes!"

verses.sloka: सैवान्येवास्मि संवृत्ता धिग् राज्ञां चञ्चलाः श्रियः ।। ६.११४.३४ ।।तांस्तांश्चित्रस्रगम्बरा ।हा राजन् सुकुमारं ते सुभ्रु सुत्वक् समुन्नसम् ।कान्तिश्रीद्युतिभिस्तुल्यमिन्दुपद्मदिवाकरैः ।। ६.११४.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: saivānyevāsmi saṁvṛttā dhig rājñāṁ cañcalāḥ śriyaḥ ।। 6.114.34 ।।tāṁstāṁścitrasragambarā ।hā rājan sukumāraṁ te subhru sutvak samunnasam ।kāntiśrīdyutibhistulyamindupadmadivākaraiḥ ।। 6.114.35 ।।

translations.english: "Oh King, My Lord! Your shiny eyes with delicate eyebrows, which used to be shiny and delicate your prominent nose brilliant skin resembling moon in pleasantness, lotus in beauty, and Sun in radiance your illuminating crown, your shining crown with gems like the peaks of mountains your coppery lips, glowing earrings, rolling eyes were pleasing earlier in the drinking parlours through inebriety, and your auspicious mouth having been indulged in pleasing talk. Today you are pierced by Rama's arrow and shattered with blood flowing, marrow of brain scattered, soiled by dust, dirtied and without any shine."

verses.sloka: किरीटकूटोज्ज्वलितं ताम्रास्यं दीप्तकुण्डलम् ।मदव्याकुललोलाक्षं भूत्वा यत् पानभूमिषु ।। ६.११४.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: kirīṭakūṭojjvalitaṁ tāmrāsyaṁ dīptakuṇḍalam ।madavyākulalolākṣaṁ bhūtvā yat pānabhūmiṣu ।। 6.114.36 ।।

translations.english: "Oh King, My Lord! Your shiny eyes with delicate eyebrows, which used to be shiny and delicate your prominent nose brilliant skin resembling moon in pleasantness, lotus in beauty, and Sun in radiance your illuminating crown, your shining crown with gems like the peaks of mountains your coppery lips, glowing earrings, rolling eyes were pleasing earlier in the drinking parlours through inebriety, and your auspicious mouth having been indulged in pleasing talk. Today you are pierced by Rama's arrow and shattered with blood flowing, marrow of brain scattered, soiled by dust, dirtied and without any shine."

verses.sloka: विविधस्रग्धरं चारु वल्गुस्मितकथं शुभम् ।तदेवाद्य तवेदं हि वक्त्रं न भ्राजते प्रभो ।। ६.११४.३७ ।।
verses.transliteration: vividhasragdharaṁ cāru valgusmitakathaṁ śubham ।tadevādya tavedaṁ hi vaktraṁ na bhrājate prabho ।। 6.114.37 ।।

translations.english: "Oh King, My Lord! Your shiny eyes with delicate eyebrows, which used to be shiny and delicate your prominent nose brilliant skin resembling moon in pleasantness, lotus in beauty, and Sun in radiance your illuminating crown, your shining crown with gems like the peaks of mountains your coppery lips, glowing earrings, rolling eyes were pleasing earlier in the drinking parlours through inebriety, and your auspicious mouth having been indulged in pleasing talk. Today you are pierced by Rama's arrow and shattered with blood flowing, marrow of brain scattered, soiled by dust, dirtied and without any shine."

verses.sloka: रामसायकनिर्भिन्नं सिक्तं रुधिरविस्रवैः ।विशीर्णमेदोमस्तिष्कं रूक्षं स्यन्दनरेणुभिः ।। ६.११४.३८ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāmasāyakanirbhinnaṁ siktaṁ rudhiravisravaiḥ ।viśīrṇamedomastiṣkaṁ rūkṣaṁ syandanareṇubhiḥ ।। 6.114.38 ।।

translations.english: "Oh King, My Lord! Your shiny eyes with delicate eyebrows, which used to be shiny and delicate your prominent nose brilliant skin resembling moon in pleasantness, lotus in beauty, and Sun in radiance your illuminating crown, your shining crown with gems like the peaks of mountains your coppery lips, glowing earrings, rolling eyes were pleasing earlier in the drinking parlours through inebriety, and your auspicious mouth having been indulged in pleasing talk. Today you are pierced by Rama's arrow and shattered with blood flowing, marrow of brain scattered, soiled by dust, dirtied and without any shine."

verses.sloka: हा पश्चिमा मे सम्प्राप्ता दशा वैधव्यकारिणी ।या मया ऽ ऽसीन्न सम्बुद्धा कदाचिदपि मन्दया ।। ६.११४.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: hā paścimā me samprāptā daśā vaidhavyakāriṇī ।yā mayā ' 'sīnna sambuddhā kadācidapi mandayā ।। 6.114.39 ।।

translations.english: "Ha! You are dead. I am widowed. I am foolish as I never thought that this stage will come."

verses.sloka: पिता दानवराजो मे भर्ता मे राक्षसेश्वरः ।पुत्रो मे शक्तनिर्जेता इत्येवं गर्विता भृशम् ।। ६.११४.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: pitā dānavarājo me bhartā me rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।putro me śaktanirjetā ityevaṁ garvitā bhṛśam ।। 6.114.40 ।।

translations.english: "My father is a king of Danavas, my husband is a Lord of Rakshasas, and my son has won over Indra, the Lord of gods, thus I was excessively proud."

verses.sloka: दृप्तारिमर्दनाः शूराः प्रख्यातबलपौरुषाः ।अकुतश्चिद्भया नाथा ममेत्यासीन्मतिर्द्दढा ।। ६.११४.४१ ।।
verses.transliteration: dṛptārimardanāḥ śūrāḥ prakhyātabalapauruṣāḥ ।akutaścidbhayā nāthā mametyāsīnmatirddaḍhā ।। 6.114.41 ।।

translations.english: "Those who are capable of protecting me are warriors, as they are capable of crushing the enemies and renowned for their pride of their strength. They had no fear from any quarter. I had this conviction in my mind."

verses.sloka: तेषामेवंप्रभावानां युष्माकं राक्षसर्षभ ।कथं भयमसम्बुद्धं मानुषादिदमागतम् ।। ६.११४.४२ ।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāmevaṁprabhāvānāṁ yuṣmākaṁ rākṣasarṣabha ।kathaṁ bhayamasambuddhaṁ mānuṣādidamāgatam ।। 6.114.42 ।।

translations.english: "O Bull among Rakshasas! You are such a famous king. This fear from a human is unknown. How did it come?"

verses.sloka: स्निग्धेन्द्रनीलनीलं तु प्रांशुशैलोपमं महत् ।केयूराङ्गदवैडूर्यमुक्तादामस्रगुज्ज्वलम् ।। ६.११४.४३ ।।
verses.transliteration: snigdhendranīlanīlaṁ tu prāṁśuśailopamaṁ mahat ।keyūrāṅgadavaiḍūryamuktādāmasragujjvalam ।। 6.114.43 ।।

translations.english: "O king! Your body which is gigantic like a mountain, dark like a sapphire adorned with Keyuras, Angadas, necklaces of cat's eye gems and pearls, which were charming when in the battlefield, and shone brightly on your body with the lustre of your jewels like a rainy cloud with flashes of lightning. It is fixed with numerous arrows cut into pieces by darts and difficult to touch. Since the darts are inserted deep into your vital parts, it is not possible to perform ablution. It is dark, soaked in blood, broken, and crushed like a mountain hit by thunderbolt. Alas, it is not possible to embrace."

verses.sloka: कान्तं विहारेष्वधिकं दीप्तं सङ्ग्रामभूमिषु ।भात्याभरणभाभिर्यद्विद्युद्भिरिव तोयदः ।। ६.११४.४४ ।।
verses.transliteration: kāntaṁ vihāreṣvadhikaṁ dīptaṁ saṅgrāmabhūmiṣu ।bhātyābharaṇabhābhiryadvidyudbhiriva toyadaḥ ।। 6.114.44 ।।

translations.english: "O king! Your body which is gigantic like a mountain, dark like a sapphire adorned with Keyuras, Angadas, necklaces of cat's eye gems and pearls, which were charming when in the battlefield, and shone brightly on your body with the lustre of your jewels like a rainy cloud with flashes of lightning. It is fixed with numerous arrows cut into pieces by darts and difficult to touch. Since the darts are inserted deep into your vital parts, it is not possible to perform ablution. It is dark, soaked in blood, broken, and crushed like a mountain hit by thunderbolt. Alas, it is not possible to embrace."

verses.sloka: तदेवाद्य शरीरं ते तीक्ष्णैर्नैकैः शरैश्चितम् ।पुनर्दुर्लभसंस्पर्शं परिष्वक्तुं न शक्यते ।। ६.११४.४५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadevādya śarīraṁ te tīkṣṇairnaikaiḥ śaraiścitam ।punardurlabhasaṁsparśaṁ pariṣvaktuṁ na śakyate ।। 6.114.45 ।।

translations.english: "O king! Your body which is gigantic like a mountain, dark like a sapphire adorned with Keyuras, Angadas, necklaces of cat's eye gems and pearls, which were charming when in the battlefield, and shone brightly on your body with the lustre of your jewels like a rainy cloud with flashes of lightning. It is fixed with numerous arrows cut into pieces by darts and difficult to touch. Since the darts are inserted deep into your vital parts, it is not possible to perform ablution. It is dark, soaked in blood, broken, and crushed like a mountain hit by thunderbolt. Alas, it is not possible to embrace."

verses.sloka: श्वाविधः शललैर्यद्वद्बाणैर्लग्नैर्निरन्तरम् ।स्वर्पितैर्मर्मसु भृशं सञ्छिन्नस्नायुबन्धनम् ।क्षितौ निपतितं राजन् श्यावं रुधिरसच्छवि ।। ६.११४.४६ ।।
verses.transliteration: śvāvidhaḥ śalalairyadvadbāṇairlagnairnirantaram ।svarpitairmarmasu bhṛśaṁ sañchinnasnāyubandhanam ।kṣitau nipatitaṁ rājan śyāvaṁ rudhirasacchavi ।। 6.114.46 ।।

translations.english: "O king! Your body which is gigantic like a mountain, dark like a sapphire adorned with Keyuras, Angadas, necklaces of cat's eye gems and pearls, which were charming when in the battlefield, and shone brightly on your body with the lustre of your jewels like a rainy cloud with flashes of lightning. It is fixed with numerous arrows cut into pieces by darts and difficult to touch. Since the darts are inserted deep into your vital parts, it is not possible to perform ablution. It is dark, soaked in blood, broken, and crushed like a mountain hit by thunderbolt. Alas, it is not possible to embrace."

verses.sloka: वज्रप्रहाराभिहतो विकीर्ण इव पर्वतः ।। ६.११४.४७ ।।्वर्पितैर्मर्मसु भृशं सञ्छिन्नस्नायुबन्धनम् ।हा स्वप्नः सत्यमेवेदं त्वं रामेण कथं हतः ।त्वं मृत्योरपि मृत्युः स्याः कथं मृत्युवशं गतः ।। ६.११४.४८ ।।
verses.transliteration: vajraprahārābhihato vikīrṇa iva parvataḥ ।। 6.114.47 ।।्varpitairmarmasu bhṛśaṁ sañchinnasnāyubandhanam ।hā svapnaḥ satyamevedaṁ tvaṁ rāmeṇa kathaṁ hataḥ ।tvaṁ mṛtyorapi mṛtyuḥ syāḥ kathaṁ mṛtyuvaśaṁ gataḥ ।। 6.114.48 ।।

translations.english: "O king! Your body which is gigantic like a mountain, dark like a sapphire adorned with Keyuras, Angadas, necklaces of cat's eye gems and pearls, which were charming when in the battlefield, and shone brightly on your body with the lustre of your jewels like a rainy cloud with flashes of lightning. It is fixed with numerous arrows cut into pieces by darts and difficult to touch. Since the darts are inserted deep into your vital parts, it is not possible to perform ablution. It is dark, soaked in blood, broken, and crushed like a mountain hit by thunderbolt. Alas, it is not possible to embrace."

verses.sloka: त्रैलोक्यवसुभोक्तारं त्रैलोक्योद्वेगदं महत् ।जेतारं लोकपालानां क्षेप्तारं शङ्करस्य च ।। ६.११४.४९ ।।
verses.transliteration: trailokyavasubhoktāraṁ trailokyodvegadaṁ mahat ।jetāraṁ lokapālānāṁ kṣeptāraṁ śaṅkarasya ca ।। 6.114.49 ।।

translations.english: "Ha! Could it be a dream? Is it true? How could you be killed by Rama? You who can kill death also, how did you fall prey to death?"

verses.sloka: दृप्तानां निग्रहीतारमाविष्कृतपराक्रमम् ।लोकक्षोभयितारं च नादैर्भूतविराविणम् ।। ६.११४.५० ।।
verses.transliteration: dṛptānāṁ nigrahītāramāviṣkṛtaparākramam ।lokakṣobhayitāraṁ ca nādairbhūtavirāviṇam ।। 6.114.50 ।।

translations.english: "You are the enjoyer of the treasures of the three worlds, you are the great annoyer of the three worlds and conqueror of the world, and you are the one who lifted up Lord Shanakara's seat."

verses.sloka: ओजसा दृप्तवाक्यानां वक्तारं रिपुसन्निधौ ।स्वयूथभृत्यवर्गाणां गोप्तारं भीमकर्मणाम् ।। ६.११४.५१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ojasā dṛptavākyānāṁ vaktāraṁ ripusannidhau ।svayūthabhṛtyavargāṇāṁ goptāraṁ bhīmakarmaṇām ।। 6.114.51 ।।

translations.english: "You are a subduer of the arrogant, who manifested prowess, who tormented the world, who made the world cry with insolent words."

verses.sloka: हन्तारं दानवेन्द्राणां यक्षाणां च सहस्रशः ।निवातकवचानां च सङ्ग्रहीतारमीश्वरम् ।। ६.११४.५२ ।।
verses.transliteration: hantāraṁ dānavendrāṇāṁ yakṣāṇāṁ ca sahasraśaḥ ।nivātakavacānāṁ ca saṅgrahītāramīśvaram ।। 6.114.52 ।।

translations.english: "He, who commanded uttering harsh words in the presence of the enemy, who protected his own brand, who killed those indulged in terrible deeds.

verses.sloka: नैकयज्ञविलोप्तारं त्रातारं स्वजनस्य च ।धर्मव्यवस्थाभेत्तारं मायास्रष्टारमाहवे ।। ६.११४.५३ ।।
verses.transliteration: naikayajñaviloptāraṁ trātāraṁ svajanasya ca ।dharmavyavasthābhettāraṁ māyāsraṣṭāramāhave ।। 6.114.53 ।।

translations.english: "He who killed thousands of chiefs of Danavas, Yakshas, and subdued Nivatakavachas in combat"

verses.sloka: देवासुरनृकन्यानामाहर्तारं ततस्ततः ।शत्रुस्त्रीशोकदातारं नेतारं स्वजनस्य च ।। ६.११४.५४ ।।
verses.transliteration: devāsuranṛkanyānāmāhartāraṁ tatastataḥ ।śatrustrīśokadātāraṁ netāraṁ svajanasya ca ।। 6.114.54 ।।

translations.english: "He, who obstructed performance of sacrificial rituals, protected his own people, who violated code of conduct in comb at by using conjuring tricks"

verses.sloka: लङ्काद्वीपस्य गोप्तारं कर्तारं भीमकर्मणाम् ।अस्माकं कामभोगानां दातारं रथिनां वरम् ।। ६.११४.५५ ।।
verses.transliteration: laṅkādvīpasya goptāraṁ kartāraṁ bhīmakarmaṇām ।asmākaṁ kāmabhogānāṁ dātāraṁ rathināṁ varam ।। 6.114.55 ।।

translations.english: "Brought by force virgin girls of Devas, suras and human beings from here and there forcibly and caused the enemy women to mourn"

verses.sloka: एवंप्रभावं भर्तारं दृष्ट्वा रामेण पातितम् ।स्थिरा ऽस्मि या देहमिमं धारयामि हतप्रिया ।। ६.११४.५६ ।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁprabhāvaṁ bhartāraṁ dṛṣṭvā rāmeṇa pātitam ।sthirā 'smi yā dehamimaṁ dhārayāmi hatapriyā ।। 6.114.56 ।।

translations.english: "In the island of Lanka, he provided for his own sexual pleasures in a concealing manner. He was the foremost among those providers of sensual pleasures."

verses.sloka: शयनेषु महार्हेषु शयित्वा राक्षसेश्वर ।इह कस्मात् प्रसुप्तो ऽसि धरण्यां रेणुपाटलः ।। ६.११४.५७ ।।
verses.transliteration: śayaneṣu mahārheṣu śayitvā rākṣaseśvara ।iha kasmāt prasupto 'si dharaṇyāṁ reṇupāṭalaḥ ।। 6.114.57 ।।

translations.english: "Such a husband of mine endowed with this kind of influence, killed by Rama, is lying here. Beholding the lover gone, I am holding this body and standing here."

verses.sloka: यदा मे तनयः शस्तो लक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिद्युधि ।तदा ऽस्म्यभिहता तीव्रमद्य त्वस्मिन्निपातिता ।। ६.११४.५८ ।।
verses.transliteration: yadā me tanayaḥ śasto lakṣmaṇenendrajidyudhi ।tadā 'smyabhihatā tīvramadya tvasminnipātitā ।। 6.114.58 ।।

translations.english: "O Lord of Rakshasas! Having slept on the best of beds, you are now lying here on the hard ground, body covered with dust. Where are you sleeping?"

verses.sloka: नाहं बन्धुजनैर्हीना हीना नाथेन तु त्वया ।विहीना कामभोगैश्च शोचिष्ये शाश्वतीः समाः ।। ६.११४.५९ ।।
verses.transliteration: nāhaṁ bandhujanairhīnā hīnā nāthena tu tvayā ।vihīnā kāmabhogaiśca śociṣye śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ।। 6.114.59 ।।

translations.english: "When my son Indrajith was killed by Lakshmana I was in intense grief. Now you have fallen."

verses.sloka: प्रपन्नो दीर्घमध्वानं राजन्नद्यासि दुर्गमम् ।नय मामपि दुःखार्तां न जीविष्ये त्वया विना ।। ६.११४.६० ।।
verses.transliteration: prapanno dīrghamadhvānaṁ rājannadyāsi durgamam ।naya māmapi duḥkhārtāṁ na jīviṣye tvayā vinā ।। 6.114.60 ।।

translations.english: "Disconnected with relatives, forsaken by you also, deprived of sensual pleasures, I shall grieve permanently."

verses.sloka: कस्मात् त्वं मां विहायेह कृपणां गन्तुमिच्छसि ।दीनां विलपितैर्मन्दां किंवा मां नाभिभाषसे ।। ६.११४.६१ ।।
verses.transliteration: kasmāt tvaṁ māṁ vihāyeha kṛpaṇāṁ gantumicchasi ।dīnāṁ vilapitairmandāṁ kiṁvā māṁ nābhibhāṣase ।। 6.114.61 ।।

translations.english: "O king! Today, take me on your journey which is very difficult. Stricken with sorrow I cannot live without you."

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा न खल्वसि क्रुद्धो मामिहानवकुण्ठिताम् ।निर्गतां नगरद्वारात् पद्भ्यामेवागतां प्रभो ।। ६.११४.६२ ।।
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā na khalvasi kruddho māmihānavakuṇṭhitām ।nirgatāṁ nagaradvārāt padbhyāmevāgatāṁ prabho ।। 6.114.62 ।।

translations.english: "You are leaving me, a desperate one, stricken, crying. Why are you desiring to go? Why are you not replying to me?"

verses.sloka: पश्येष्टदार दारांस्ते भ्रष्टलज्जावकुण्ठितान् ।बहिर्निष्पतितान् सर्वान् कथं दृष्ट्वा न कुप्यसि ।। ६.११४.६३ ।।
verses.transliteration: paśyeṣṭadāra dārāṁste bhraṣṭalajjāvakuṇṭhitān ।bahirniṣpatitān sarvān kathaṁ dṛṣṭvā na kupyasi ।। 6.114.63 ।।

translations.english: "Lord! How is it that you are not angry seeing me coming forth walking through the city gate?"

verses.sloka: अयं क्रीडासहायस्ते नाथ लालप्यते जनः ।न चैनमाश्वासयसे किं वा न बहुमन्यसे ।। ६.११४.६४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ayaṁ krīḍāsahāyaste nātha lālapyate janaḥ ।na cainamāśvāsayase kiṁ vā na bahumanyase ।। 6.114.64 ।।

translations.english: "O lover of wives! Your wives have come out leaving their veils from their abode to see you. See them, and how is it that you are not angry?"

verses.sloka: यास्त्वया विधवा राजन् कृता नैकाः कुलस्त्रियः ।पतिव्रता धर्मपरा गुरुशुश्रूषणे रताः ।ताभिः शोकाभितप्ताभिः शप्तः परवशं गतः ।। ६.११४.६५ ।।
verses.transliteration: yāstvayā vidhavā rājan kṛtā naikāḥ kulastriyaḥ ।pativratā dharmaparā guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ ।tābhiḥ śokābhitaptābhiḥ śaptaḥ paravaśaṁ gataḥ ।। 6.114.65 ।।

translations.english: "These people who were with you are always sporting my Lord. Why do you not call them, why are you not consoling them, or inviting them?"

verses.sloka: त्वया विप्रकृताभिर्यत्तदा शप्तं तदागतम् ।। ६.११४.६६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tvayā viprakṛtābhiryattadā śaptaṁ tadāgatam ।। 6.114.66 ।।

translations.english: "King! Chaste women of noble lineage being righteous, serving the elders have been widowed by you. Because of their curse, you have fallen under the sway of your enemy and because of that, this has come to you."

verses.sloka: प्रवादः सत्य एवायं त्वां प्रति प्रायशो नृप ।पतिव्रतानां नाकस्मात् पतन्त्यश्रूणि भूतले ।। ६.११४.६७ ।।
verses.transliteration: pravādaḥ satya evāyaṁ tvāṁ prati prāyaśo nṛpa ।pativratānāṁ nākasmāt patantyaśrūṇi bhūtale ।। 6.114.67 ।।

translations.english: "King! Chaste women of noble lineage being righteous, serving the elders have been widowed by you. Because of their curse, you have fallen under the sway of your enemy and because of that, this has come to you."

verses.sloka: कथं च नाम ते राजन् लोकानाक्रम्य तेजसा ।नारीचौर्यमिदं क्षुद्रं कृतं शौण्डीर्यमानिना ।। ६.११४.६८ ।।
verses.transliteration: kathaṁ ca nāma te rājan lokānākramya tejasā ।nārīcauryamidaṁ kṣudraṁ kṛtaṁ śauṇḍīryamāninā ।। 6.114.68 ।।

translations.english: "King! 'The tears of noble women should not fall on the earth's surface' is a popular saying. This calamity is truly a result to you in return."

verses.sloka: अपनीयाश्रमाद्रामं यन्मृगच्छद्मना त्वया ।आनीता रामपत्नी सा तत्ते कातर्यलक्षणम् ।। ६.११४.६९ ।।
verses.transliteration: apanīyāśramādrāmaṁ yanmṛgacchadmanā tvayā ।ānītā rāmapatnī sā tatte kātaryalakṣaṇam ।। 6.114.69 ।।

translations.english: "King! You have invaded the world by your brilliance and were proud of your heroism. How did you do this mean act of abducting a woman?"

verses.sloka: कातर्यं च न ते युद्धे कदाचित् संस्मराम्यहम् ।तत्तुभाग्यविपर्यासान्नूनं ते पक्वलक्षणम् ।। ६.११४.७० ।।
verses.transliteration: kātaryaṁ ca na te yuddhe kadācit saṁsmarāmyaham ।tattubhāgyaviparyāsānnūnaṁ te pakvalakṣaṇam ।। 6.114.70 ।।

translations.english: "By your cowardly action of creating an illusory deer, you have brought Rama's consort from the hermitage."

verses.sloka: अतीतानागतार्थज्ञो वर्तमानविचक्षणः ।मैथिलीमाहृतां दृष्ट्वा ध्यात्वा निश्वस्य चायतम् ।। ६.११४.७१ ।।
verses.transliteration: atītānāgatārthajño vartamānavicakṣaṇaḥ ।maithilīmāhṛtāṁ dṛṣṭvā dhyātvā niśvasya cāyatam ।। 6.114.71 ।।

translations.english: "Indeed, I do not remember you being cowardly in war. The timidness that appeared in you is a sign of the adverseness of fate, for your destruction."

verses.sloka: सत्यवाक् स महाभागो देवरो मे यदब्रवीत् ।सो ऽयं राक्षसमुख्यानां विनाशः पर्युपस्थितः ।कामक्रोधसमुत्थेन व्यसनेन प्रसङ्गिना ।। ६.११४.७२ ।।
verses.transliteration: satyavāk sa mahābhāgo devaro me yadabravīt ।so 'yaṁ rākṣasamukhyānāṁ vināśaḥ paryupasthitaḥ ।kāmakrodhasamutthena vyasanena prasaṅginā ।। 6.114.72 ।।

translations.english: "Mighty armed King! Your brother, who is a knower of matters relating to future, present and past, a truthful one, after your getting Mythili, thought for a while and sighing spoke this. 'The destruction of Rakshasa chiefs is now sure to happen', has come true.' The desire for sensual pleasures and anger has resulted in your death and resulting in this calamity."

verses.sloka: निर्वृत्तस्त्वत्कृते ऽनर्थः सो ऽयं मूलहरो महान् ।त्वया कृतमिदं सर्वमनाथं रक्षसां कुलम् ।। ६.११४.७३ ।।
verses.transliteration: nirvṛttastvatkṛte 'narthaḥ so 'yaṁ mūlaharo mahān ।tvayā kṛtamidaṁ sarvamanāthaṁ rakṣasāṁ kulam ।। 6.114.73 ।।

translations.english: "Mighty armed King! Your brother, who is a knower of matters relating to future, present and past, a truthful one, after your getting Mythili, thought for a while and sighing spoke this. 'The destruction of Rakshasa chiefs is now sure to happen', has come true.' The desire for sensual pleasures and anger has resulted in your death and resulting in this calamity."

verses.sloka: न हि त्वं शोचितव्यो मे प्रख्यातबलपौरुषः ।स्त्रीस्वभावात्तु मे बुद्धिः कारुण्ये परिवर्तते ।। ६.११४.७४ ।।
verses.transliteration: na hi tvaṁ śocitavyo me prakhyātabalapauruṣaḥ ।strīsvabhāvāttu me buddhiḥ kāruṇye parivartate ।। 6.114.74 ।।

translations.english: "Mighty armed King! Your brother, who is a knower of matters relating to future, present and past, a truthful one, after your getting Mythili, thought for a while and sighing spoke this. 'The destruction of Rakshasa chiefs is now sure to happen', has come true.' The desire for sensual pleasures and anger has resulted in your death and resulting in this calamity."

verses.sloka: सुकृतं दुष्कृतं च त्वं गृहीत्वा स्वां गतिं गतः ।आत्मानमनुशोचामि त्वद्वियोगेन दुःखिता ।। ६.११४.७५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sukṛtaṁ duṣkṛtaṁ ca tvaṁ gṛhītvā svāṁ gatiṁ gataḥ ।ātmānamanuśocāmi tvadviyogena duḥkhitā ।। 6.114.75 ।।

translations.english: "By this major disaster of yours, the very root has been destroyed. With the extermination of the Rakshasas, the entire Rakshasa clan is orphaned now by your action."

verses.sloka: सुहृदां हितकामानां न श्रुतं वचनं त्वया ।भ्रातऽणां चापि कार्त्स्न्येन हितमुक्तं त्वया ऽनघ ।। ६.११४.७६ ।।
verses.transliteration: suhṛdāṁ hitakāmānāṁ na śrutaṁ vacanaṁ tvayā ।bhrāta'ṇāṁ cāpi kārtsnyena hitamuktaṁ tvayā 'nagha ।। 6.114.76 ।।

translations.english: "You are famous for your strength and courage. I do not need to wail for you. Being a woman, by nature I am compassionate, and my mind is moving towards sorrow."

verses.sloka: हेत्वर्थयुक्तं विधिवत् श्रेयस्करमदारुणम् ।विभीषणेनाभिहितं न कृतं हेतुमत्त्वया ।। ६.११४.७७ ।।
verses.transliteration: hetvarthayuktaṁ vidhivat śreyaskaramadāruṇam ।vibhīṣaṇenābhihitaṁ na kṛtaṁ hetumattvayā ।। 6.114.77 ।।

translations.english: "You have taken away the good and evil deeds done by your death. I'm thinking of myself and wailing."

verses.sloka: मारीचकुम्भकर्णाभ्यां वाक्यं मम पितुस्तदा ।न श्रुतं वीर्यमत्तेन तस्येदं फलमीदृशम् ।। ६.११४.७८ ।।
verses.transliteration: mārīcakumbhakarṇābhyāṁ vākyaṁ mama pitustadā ।na śrutaṁ vīryamattena tasyedaṁ phalamīdṛśam ।। 6.114.78 ।।

translations.english: "O Ten headed king! You did not heed the good words of advice given by your friends. You did not totally heed the good words spoken by your brothers."

verses.sloka: नीलजीमूतसङ्काश पीताम्बर शुभाङ्गद ।। ६.११४.७९ ।।
verses.transliteration: nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśa pītāmbara śubhāṅgada ।। 6.114.79 ।।

translations.english: "You have not listened to the meaningful, agreeable and reasonable advice given according to tradition by Vibheeshana."

verses.sloka: स्वगात्राणि विनिक्षिप्य किं शेषे रुधिराप्लुतः ।प्रसुप्त इव शोकार्तां किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे ।। ६.११४.८० ।।
verses.transliteration: svagātrāṇi vinikṣipya kiṁ śeṣe rudhirāplutaḥ ।prasupta iva śokārtāṁ kiṁ māṁ na pratibhāṣase ।। 6.114.80 ।।

translations.english: "You did not take the advice of both Maricha and Kumbhakarna. You have also not taken the advice of my father because of the pride of your valour. This kind of result is the consequence of that."

verses.sloka: महावीर्यस्य दक्षस्य संयुगेष्वपलायिनः ।यातुधानस्य दौहित्र किं च मां नाभ्युदीक्षसे ।। ६.११४.८१ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahāvīryasya dakṣasya saṁyugeṣvapalāyinaḥ ।yātudhānasya dauhitra kiṁ ca māṁ nābhyudīkṣase ।। 6.114.81 ।।

translations.english: "Resembling a dark cloud clad in yellow silk, why are you lying like this with limbs thrown down and body covered with blood?"

verses.sloka: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ किं शेषे प्राप्ते परिभवे नवे ।अद्य वै निर्भयां लङ्कां प्रविष्टाः सूर्यरश्मयः ।। ६.११४.८२ ।।
verses.transliteration: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha kiṁ śeṣe prāpte paribhave nave ।adya vai nirbhayāṁ laṅkāṁ praviṣṭāḥ sūryaraśmayaḥ ।। 6.114.82 ।।

translations.english: "You are sleeping like this while I am stricken with grief. Why are you not replying to me? I am the granddaughter of Malyavantha, a great hero who fought with Daksha. Why are you disowning me and not answering me?"

verses.sloka: येन सूदयसे शत्रून् समरे सूर्यवर्चसा ।वज्रो वज्रधरस्येव सो ऽयं ते सततार्चितः ।। ६.११४.८३ ।।
verses.transliteration: yena sūdayase śatrūn samare sūryavarcasā ।vajro vajradharasyeva so 'yaṁ te satatārcitaḥ ।। 6.114.83 ।।

translations.english: "Get up, Rise up. When you are insulted why are you lying down? Because you are lying down, even the radiance of the Sun has entered Lanka without fear."

verses.sloka: रणे शत्रुप्रहरणो हमजालपरिष्कृतः ।परिघो व्यवकीर्णस्ते बाणैश्छिन्नः सहस्रधा ।। ६.११४.८४ ।।
verses.transliteration: raṇe śatrupraharaṇo hamajālapariṣkṛtaḥ ।parigho vyavakīrṇaste bāṇaiśchinnaḥ sahasradhā ।। 6.114.84 ।।

translations.english: "The iron bar of yours which is effulgent like the Sun and closely resembles the thunderbolt of Indra, with which you have terminated your enemies in the combat, which is regularly worshipped by you, which is adorned with a network of gold, is broken into thousand pieces and lies scattered."

verses.sloka: प्रियामिवोपगुह्य त्वं शेषे समरमेदिनीम् ।अप्रियामिव कस्माच्च मां नेच्छस्यभिभाषितुम् ।। ६.११४.८५ ।।
verses.transliteration: priyāmivopaguhya tvaṁ śeṣe samaramedinīm ।apriyāmiva kasmācca māṁ necchasyabhibhāṣitum ।। 6.114.85 ।।

translations.english: "The iron bar of yours which is effulgent like the Sun and closely resembles the thunderbolt of Indra, with which you have terminated your enemies in the combat, which is regularly worshipped by you, which is adorned with a network of gold, is broken into thousand pieces and lies scattered."

verses.sloka: धिगस्तु हृदयं यस्या ममेदं न सहस्रधा ।त्वयि मञ्चत्वमापन्ने फलते शोकपीडितम् ।। ६.११४.८६ ।।
verses.transliteration: dhigastu hṛdayaṁ yasyā mamedaṁ na sahasradhā ।tvayi mañcatvamāpanne phalate śokapīḍitam ।। 6.114.86 ।।

translations.english: "You are lying in the battlefield embracing it as if it is a loved one. Why are you not willing to answer me?"

verses.sloka: इत्येवं विलपन्त्येव बाष्पव्याकुललोचना ।स्नेहावस्कन्नहृदया देवी मोहमुपागमत् ।। ६.११४.८७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityevaṁ vilapantyeva bāṣpavyākulalocanā ।snehāvaskannahṛdayā devī mohamupāgamat ।। 6.114.87 ।।

translations.english: "You have returned to the five elements. This heart of mine distressed with grief is not breaking into a thousand pieces."

verses.sloka: कश्मलाभिहता सन्ना बभौ सा रावणोरसि ।सन्ध्या ऽनुरक्ते जलदे दीप्ता विद्युदिवासिते ।। ६.११४.८८ ।।
verses.transliteration: kaśmalābhihatā sannā babhau sā rāvaṇorasi ।sandhyā 'nurakte jalade dīptā vidyudivāsite ।। 6.114.88 ।।

translations.english: Wailing in this way, eyes filled with tears, heart filled with extreme love, (Mandodari) she was in delusion.

verses.sloka: तथागतां समुत्पत्य सपत्न्यस्ता भृशातुराः ।पर्यवस्थापयामासू रुदन्त्यो रुदतीं भृशम् ।। ६.११४.८९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tathāgatāṁ samutpatya sapatnyastā bhṛśāturāḥ ।paryavasthāpayāmāsū rudantyo rudatīṁ bhṛśam ।। 6.114.89 ।।

translations.english: In a state of unconsciousness, when Mandodari, fell on Ravana's chest, shrunk in agony, she was like a flash of lightning glowing in a rainy cloud reddened by the blow of twilight.

verses.sloka: न ते सुविदिता देवि लोकानां स्थितिरध्रुवा ।दशाविभागपर्याये राज्ञां चञ्चलया श्रिया ।। ६.११४.९० ।।
verses.transliteration: na te suviditā devi lokānāṁ sthitiradhruvā ।daśāvibhāgaparyāye rājñāṁ cañcalayā śriyā ।। 6.114.90 ।।

translations.english: The cowives who had come there weeping aloud and distressed, lifted up roaring Mandodari quickly.

verses.sloka: इत्येवमुच्यमाना सा सशब्दं प्ररुरोद ह ।स्नापयन्ती त्वभिमुखौ स्तनावस्राम्बुविस्रवैः ।। ६.११४.९१ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityevamucyamānā sā saśabdaṁ praruroda ha ।snāpayantī tvabhimukhau stanāvasrāmbuvisravaiḥ ।। 6.114.91 ।।

translations.english: "Devi! Not that you do not know that when fortune changes in the world, dynasty changes. Fortune is not steady."

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामो विभीषणमुवाच ह ।संस्कारः क्रियतां भ्रातुः स्त्रियश्चैता निवर्तय ।। ६.११४.९२ ।।
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare rāmo vibhīṣaṇamuvāca ha ।saṁskāraḥ kriyatāṁ bhrātuḥ striyaścaitā nivartaya ।। 6.114.92 ।।

translations.english: While Mandodari was being counselled by the co wives like this, she was weeping, shedding tears on her breast as well as bathing her face. She once again wept making a loud sound.

verses.sloka: तं प्रश्रितस्ततो रामं श्रुतवाक्यो विभीषणः ।विमृश्य बुद्ध्या धर्मज्ञो धर्मार्थसहितं वचः ।रामस्यैवानुवृत्त्यर्थमुत्तरं प्रत्यभाषत ।। ६.११४.९३ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ praśritastato rāmaṁ śrutavākyo vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।vimṛśya buddhyā dharmajño dharmārthasahitaṁ vacaḥ ।rāmasyaivānuvṛttyarthamuttaraṁ pratyabhāṣata ।। 6.114.93 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Rama spoke to Vibheeshana like this." Let the obsequies be carried out and all the women comforted."

verses.sloka: त्यक्तधर्मव्रतं क्रूरं नृशंसमनृतं तथा ।नाहमर्हो ऽस्मि संस्कर्तुं परदाराभिमर्शिनम् ।। ६.११४.९४ ।।
verses.transliteration: tyaktadharmavrataṁ krūraṁ nṛśaṁsamanṛtaṁ tathā ।nāhamarho 'smi saṁskartuṁ paradārābhimarśinam ।। 6.114.94 ।।

translations.english: Then the wise and righteous Vibheeshana thinking made a wholesome and righteous submission in the following words.

verses.sloka: भ्रातृरूपो हि मे शत्रुरेषसर्वाहिते रतः ।रावणो नार्हते पूजां पूज्यो ऽपि गुरुगौरवात् ।। ६.११४.९५ ।।
verses.transliteration: bhrātṛrūpo hi me śatrureṣasarvāhite rataḥ ।rāvaṇo nārhate pūjāṁ pūjyo 'pi gurugauravāt ।। 6.114.95 ।।

translations.english: "This Ravana had given up righteous conduct, was cruel, merciless, untrue, and had laid hands on others' wives. I do not deserve to perform obsequies to him.

verses.sloka: नृशंस इति मां कामं वक्ष्यन्ति मनुजा भुवि ।श्रुत्वा तस्यागुणान् सर्वे वक्ष्यन्ति सुकृतं पुनः ।। ६.११४.९६ ।।
verses.transliteration: nṛśaṁsa iti māṁ kāmaṁ vakṣyanti manujā bhuvi ।śrutvā tasyāguṇān sarve vakṣyanti sukṛtaṁ punaḥ ।। 6.114.96 ।।

translations.english: "This Ravana remained doing harm to all and does not deserve the respect of his elder brother, or prayers. He is an enemy in the form of brother. He does not deserve to be worshipped.

verses.sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा परमप्रीतो रामो धर्मभृतां वरः ।विभीषणमुवाचेदं वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकोविदम् ।। ६.११४.९७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā paramaprīto rāmo dharmabhṛtāṁ varaḥ ।vibhīṣaṇamuvācedaṁ vākyajño vākyakovidam ।। 6.114.97 ।।

translations.english: "If I am not performing obsequies to my elder brother, the people in this world will call me ruthless. Again, on hearing his blemishes they will say that it is good not to do it for him."

verses.sloka: तवापि मे प्रियं कार्यं त्वत्प्रभावाच्च मे जितम् ।अवश्यं तु क्षमं वाच्यो मया त्वं राक्षसेश्वर ।। ६.११४.९८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tavāpi me priyaṁ kāryaṁ tvatprabhāvācca me jitam ।avaśyaṁ tu kṣamaṁ vācyo mayā tvaṁ rākṣaseśvara ।। 6.114.98 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Vibheeshana's words, Rama, who is good at expression, very affectionately, upholding virtues, spoke as follows to Vibheeshana.

verses.sloka: अधर्मानृतसंयुक्तः कामं त्वेष निशाचरः ।तेजस्वी बलवान् शूरो संयुगेषु च नित्यशः ।। ६.११४.९९ ।।
verses.transliteration: adharmānṛtasaṁyuktaḥ kāmaṁ tveṣa niśācaraḥ ।tejasvī balavān śūro saṁyugeṣu ca nityaśaḥ ।। 6.114.99 ।।

translations.english: "O Lord of Rakshasas! You are dear to me. It is by your strength I could be victorious. I have to do some kind deed for you.

verses.sloka: शतक्रतुमुखैर्देवैः श्रूयते न पराजितः ।महात्मा बलसम्पन्नो रावणो लोकरावणः ।। ६.११४.१०० ।।
verses.transliteration: śatakratumukhairdevaiḥ śrūyate na parājitaḥ ।mahātmā balasampanno rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ ।। 6.114.100 ।।

translations.english: "This nightranger is full of unrighteousness and untrue. But he was a strong, energetic hero in combat."

verses.sloka: मरणान्तानि वैराणि निर्वृत्तं नः प्रयोजनम् ।क्रियतामस्य संस्कारो ममाप्येष यथा तव ।। ६.११४.१०१ ।।
verses.transliteration: maraṇāntāni vairāṇi nirvṛttaṁ naḥ prayojanam ।kriyatāmasya saṁskāro mamāpyeṣa yathā tava ।। 6.114.101 ।।

translations.english: "Though he is richly endowed with prowess, he is a tyranny to the world, who has performed a hundred sacrifices (like Indra) and never got defeated, I heard."

verses.sloka: त्वत्सकाशाद्दशग्रीवः संस्कारं विधिपूर्वकम् ।प्राप्तुमर्हति धर्मज्ञ त्वं यशोभाग् भविष्यसि ।। ६.११४.१०२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tvatsakāśāddaśagrīvaḥ saṁskāraṁ vidhipūrvakam ।prāptumarhati dharmajña tvaṁ yaśobhāg bhaviṣyasi ।। 6.114.102 ।।

translations.english: "There is no hostility after death for heroes. Let us perform his obsequies. I am also like that in this regard.

verses.sloka: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा त्वरमाणो विभीषणः ।संस्कारेणानुरूपेण योजयामास रावणम् ।। ६.११४.१०३ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā tvaramāṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।saṁskāreṇānurūpeṇa yojayāmāsa rāvaṇam ।। 6.114.103 ।।

translations.english: "Ten headed Ravana being so (knower of righteousness), he deserves your performance of his last rites as per tradition and righteously You will attain fame by doing this deed."

verses.sloka: चितां चन्दनकाष्ठानां पद्मकोशीरसंवृताम् ।ब्राह्म्या संवेशयाञ्चक्रू राङ्कवास्तरणावृताम् ।। ६.११४.१०४ ।।
verses.transliteration: citāṁ candanakāṣṭhānāṁ padmakośīrasaṁvṛtām ।brāhmyā saṁveśayāñcakrū rāṅkavāstaraṇāvṛtām ।। 6.114.104 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Raghava's words, Vibheeshana hastened to perform the last rites of his brother Ravana who had been killed.

verses.sloka: वर्तते वेदविहितो राज्ञो वै पश्चिमः क्रतुः ।प्रचक्रू राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पितृमेधमनुक्रमम् ।। ६.११४.१०५ ।।
verses.transliteration: vartate vedavihito rājño vai paścimaḥ kratuḥ ।pracakrū rākṣasendrasya pitṛmedhamanukramam ।। 6.114.105 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana entered the city of Lanka and carried out fire sacrifice quickly for Ravana, the king of Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: वेदिं च दक्षिणप्राच्यां यथास्थानं च पावकम् ।पृषदाज्येन सम्पूर्णं स्रुवं सर्वे प्रचिक्षिपुः ।। ६.११४.१०६ ।।
verses.transliteration: vediṁ ca dakṣiṇaprācyāṁ yathāsthānaṁ ca pāvakam ।pṛṣadājyena sampūrṇaṁ sruvaṁ sarve pracikṣipuḥ ।। 6.114.106 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana arranged to get excellent carts, fires maintained by Ravana, priests, so also sandalwood, and many kinds of wood, fragrant perfumes, sandals, sweet smelling odours, gems, pearls, and corals and proceeded with obsequies.

verses.sloka: पादयोः शकटं प्रादुरन्तरूर्वोरुलूखलम् ।दारुपात्राणि सर्वाणि अरणिं चोत्तरारणिम् ।दत्त्वा तु मुसलं चान्यद्यथा स्थानं विचक्षणाः ।। ६.११४.१०७ ।।
verses.transliteration: pādayoḥ śakaṭaṁ prādurantarūrvorulūkhalam ।dārupātrāṇi sarvāṇi araṇiṁ cottarāraṇim ।dattvā tu musalaṁ cānyadyathā sthānaṁ vicakṣaṇāḥ ।। 6.114.107 ।।

translations.english: Vibheeshana arranged to get excellent carts, fires maintained by Ravana, priests, so also sandalwood, and many kinds of wood, fragrant perfumes, sandals, sweet smelling odours, gems, pearls, and corals and proceeded with obsequies.

verses.sloka: शास्त्रदृष्टेन विधिना महर्षिविहितेन च ।तत्र मेध्यं पशुं हत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य राक्षसाः ।। ६.११४.१०८ ।।
verses.transliteration: śāstradṛṣṭena vidhinā maharṣivihitena ca ।tatra medhyaṁ paśuṁ hatvā rākṣasendrasya rākṣasāḥ ।। 6.114.108 ।।

translations.english: Surrounded by Rakshasas, in a short time he returned with Malyavan (Maternal uncle of Ravana) and Vibheeshana initiated the task.

verses.sloka: परिस्तरणिकां राज्ञो घृताक्तां समवेशयन् ।। ६.११४.१०९ ।।
verses.transliteration: paristaraṇikāṁ rājño ghṛtāktāṁ samaveśayan ।। 6.114.109 ।।

translations.english: As the dead body of Ravana was lifted up for final beatitude, panegyrists hailed him with blasts of several musical instruments and praised him with their faces bathed in tears. The golden cart was decorated with beautiful, picturesque, wonderful pictures and flags. Logs of wood were placed on the body and consecrated by sprinkling fragrant water. With Vibheeshana in the forefront, faces turned to the southern side, all proceeded.

verses.sloka: गन्धैर्माल्यैरलङ्कृत्य रावणं दीनमानसाः ।विभीषणसहायास्ते वस्त्रैश्च विविधैरपि ।। ६.११४.११० ।।
verses.transliteration: gandhairmālyairalaṅkṛtya rāvaṇaṁ dīnamānasāḥ ।vibhīṣaṇasahāyāste vastraiśca vividhairapi ।। 6.114.110 ।।

translations.english: As the dead body of Ravana was lifted up for final beatitude, panegyrists hailed him with blasts of several musical instruments and praised him with their faces bathed in tears. The golden cart was decorated with beautiful, picturesque, wonderful pictures and flags. Logs of wood were placed on the body and consecrated by sprinkling fragrant water. With Vibheeshana in the forefront, faces turned to the southern side, all proceeded.

verses.sloka: लाजैश्चावकिरन्ति स्म बाष्पपूर्णमुखास्तदा ।। ६.११४.१११ ।।
verses.transliteration: lājaiścāvakiranti sma bāṣpapūrṇamukhāstadā ।। 6.114.111 ।।

translations.english: As the dead body of Ravana was lifted up for final beatitude, panegyrists hailed him with blasts of several musical instruments and praised him with their faces bathed in tears. The golden cart was decorated with beautiful, picturesque, wonderful pictures and flags. Logs of wood were placed on the body and consecrated by sprinkling fragrant water. With Vibheeshana in the forefront, faces turned to the southern side, all proceeded.

verses.sloka: ददौ च पावकं तस्य विधियुक्तं विभीषणः ।। ६.११४.११२ ।।
verses.transliteration: dadau ca pāvakaṁ tasya vidhiyuktaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.114.112 ।।

translations.english: Then Advarya lighted the fires that started glowing up. All the ogres paid their respects seeking refuge and followed.

verses.sloka: स्नात्वा चैवार्द्रवस्त्रेण तिलान् दूर्वाभिमिश्रितान् ।उदकेन च संमिश्रान् प्रदाय विधिपूर्वकम् ।। ६.११४.११३ ।।
verses.transliteration: snātvā caivārdravastreṇa tilān dūrvābhimiśritān ।udakena ca saṁmiśrān pradāya vidhipūrvakam ।। 6.114.113 ।।

translations.english: All the women from the gynaeceum weeping aloud from all sides hastened at quick paces and followed sobbing.

verses.sloka: प्रदाय चोदकं तस्मै मूर्ध्ना चैनं नमस्य च ।ताः स्त्रियो ऽनुनयामास सान्त्वमुक्त्वा पुनःपुनः ।। ६.११४.११४ ।।
verses.transliteration: pradāya codakaṁ tasmai mūrdhnā cainaṁ namasya ca ।tāḥ striyo 'nunayāmāsa sāntvamuktvā punaḥpunaḥ ।। 6.114.114 ।।

translations.english: As they advanced forth with Ravana's body, they placed it in a consecrated place. All were highly afflicted with grief. Logs of sandal wood, blocks of Padmaka wood and finally fragrant root of Usira plant, and Brahmya grass were placed on the body. It was covered with the skin of antelope. The last rites of the king were carried out with vedic rites.

verses.sloka: गम्यतामिति ताः सर्वा विविशुर्नगरं तदा ।प्रविष्टासु च सर्वासु राक्षसीषु विभीषणः ।रामपार्श्वमुपागम्य तदा ऽतिष्ठद्विनीतवत् ।। ६.११४.११५ ।।
verses.transliteration: gamyatāmiti tāḥ sarvā viviśurnagaraṁ tadā ।praviṣṭāsu ca sarvāsu rākṣasīṣu vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।rāmapārśvamupāgamya tadā 'tiṣṭhadvinītavat ।। 6.114.115 ।।

translations.english: As they advanced forth with Ravana's body, they placed it in a consecrated place. All were highly afflicted with grief. Logs of sandal wood, blocks of Padmaka wood and finally fragrant root of Usira plant, and Brahmya grass were placed on the body. It was covered with the skin of antelope. The last rites of the king were carried out with vedic rites.

verses.sloka: रामो ऽपि सह सैन्येन समुग्रीवः सलक्ष्मणः ।हर्षं लेभे रिपुं हत्वा यथा वृत्रं शतक्रतुः ।। ६.११४.११६ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāmo 'pi saha sainyena samugrīvaḥ salakṣmaṇaḥ ।harṣaṁ lebhe ripuṁ hatvā yathā vṛtraṁ śatakratuḥ ।। 6.114.116 ।।

translations.english: Then proceeding in sequence constructing an altar in the southeast and placing sacrificial fire in a proper place, they duly performed in honour of the ruler of Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे चतुर्दशोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। ११४ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe caturdaśottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 114 ।।

translations.english: Then they poured a ladle full of ghee mixed with curd on his shoulders and placed a cart on his feet and a wooden mortar on his thighs.
